hud.status.no_api: API not configured, check config file
gui.title: ChatSummon Settings
gui.always_listening.tooltip: Automatically listen to the microphone when the mod starts
gui.provider.tooltip: Select the speech recognition provider. Both ByteDance (Doubao) and Alibaba Cloud (NLS) are supported; fill in the corresponding API credentials for the selected provider
gui.api_key.tooltip: Volcengine new-console API Key (X-Api-Key), hidden with asterisks on input
gui.resource_id.tooltip: Select the Doubao streaming speech recognition model (resource ID), hourly or concurrent; must match what is enabled on the platform
gui.model.restart_tip: Restart the game for model changes to take effect
gui.cluster.tooltip: Business cluster (instance ID); must pair with the resource ID
gui.boosting_table_id.tooltip:
Fill in the cloud hotword table ID created in the selected provider's console.
· ByteDance: create a hotword table under "Voice - Self-learning Platform - Hotword Management", fill in boosting_table_id.
· Alibaba Cloud: create under "Custom Hotwords" in the NLS console, fill in vocabulary_id.
Hotword IDs are not interchangeable between providers; fill in the one matching your selected provider.
gui.aliyun_app_key.tooltip: Alibaba Cloud NLS project Appkey (from the console project), hidden with asterisks on input
gui.aliyun_access_key_id.tooltip: Alibaba Cloud account AccessKey ID (used to obtain a temporary token), hidden with asterisks on input
gui.aliyun_access_key_secret.tooltip: Alibaba Cloud account AccessKey Secret (used to obtain a temporary token), hidden with asterisks on input
gui.microphone.tooltip:
Select the input microphone from the dropdown; system default uses the current default device.
The list shows all capture-capable devices (unfiltered, including Stereo Mix / VoiceMeeter etc.).

Note: devices with "Stereo Mix / What U Hear / VoiceMeeter" in the name typically capture system playback or virtual mix; selecting them by mistake will route teammates' voices into your recognition and count summons against you.
gui.enable_noise_reduction.tooltip:
Enable spectral subtraction noise reduction to suppress background noise (AC, keyboard, etc.) and improve recognition accuracy in noisy environments.
Toggle and strength changes apply immediately after saving, no restart required.
Note: NR cannot separate overlapping human voices (e.g. headset crosstalk); ensure you have not accidentally selected a stereo-mix capture device.
gui.noise_reduction_strength.tooltip:
Noise reduction strength level (only active when realtime NR is enabled):
- 1 Light: preserve more speech detail, gentle stationary-noise suppression
- 2 Medium: default balanced setting, noise vs naturalness
- 3 Strong: aggressive suppression, use only in very noisy environments
gui.hud_position.tooltip: Select the preset layout of HUD info on screen
gui.recognition_threshold.tooltip: Ignore results below this confidence (0~1); higher is stricter
gui.match_delay.tooltip: How long to wait after recognition pauses before matching and summoning (0~10 s, up to one decimal)
gui.summon_range.tooltip: Maximum distance (blocks) between target and speaker
gui.max_mobs.tooltip: Maximum number of mobs spawned per summon
gui.summon_at_speaker: Summon at Speaker When No Target
gui.summon_at_speaker.tooltip: Whether to summon at the speaker's position when no other player is in range
